notes: Phase 2Y narrow vertical slice for proving real-data fixture to deterministic adapter to QA scene integration.
Identity, address, and category reuse existing reviewed source-evidence references.
Geometry is human-prepared or estimated from source context for QA review only; it is not product-ready, survey-grade, or an exact frontage/facade/entrance claim.
Normal mode must not render this real-data QA layer.

statusValues.source_backed: Supported by existing reviewed source-evidence for review/demo use.
statusValues.human_prepared: Prepared locally by a human as a small sample for scene-generation proof; not exact source geometry.
statusValues.estimated_from_source: Estimated from source context and current scene alignment, not exact measured geometry.
statusValues.generated_placeholder: Generated from deterministic adapter rules to complete the QA skeleton.
statusValues.blocked: Blocked from exact/product/public claims pending stronger evidence and approval.
